meta.name: Check job descriptions for bias and inclusive language with OpenAI

name: Job Description Bias & Inclusive Language Checker (AI Report)

parameters.content:
This workflow checks a job description for language that could quietly discourage qualified candidates from applying. It scores overall inclusivity, reads the gender coding of the wording, and flags specific phrases with plain English explanations and inclusive rewrites for each one. It is built for recruiters, hiring managers, and small HR teams who want a fast second opinion on a job post before it goes live.

### How it works
1. The Form Trigger collects the job description text, plus an optional role title and industry.
2. Map Form Fields cleans the raw form data into simple, consistent fields.
3. Long Enough? checks the text is at least 150 characters. Short text returns a friendly error page instead of wasting an AI call.
4. Prepare Input trims very long text so it stays inside the model's limits.
5. Analyze Bias sends the text to the AI model, which returns a structured score, gender coding read, and a list of flagged phrases with rewrites.
6. Build HTML Report formats that data into a report, and Send Report shows it back on the same form page.

### Setup steps
1. Open node 6, OpenAI Chat Model, and connect your own OpenAI credential, or swap in any other chat model node such as Anthropic or Gemini.
2. Activate the workflow, then open the Form Trigger's production URL to test it end to end.
3. No other accounts, API keys, or placeholders are needed.

### Customization
- Change the 150 character minimum in node 3, Long Enough?, for a stricter or looser check.
- Edit the prompt inside node 9, Analyze Bias, to add or remove flag categories.
- Adjust the colors and styling inside node 10, Build HTML Report, to match your own brand.

## 1. Collect and validate the job description
Collects the job description through a form, checks it has at least 150 characters, and trims very long text before it reaches the AI model. Short submissions get a friendly error page instead of an AI call.

## 2. Analyze bias and build the report
The AI model reads the job description against a structured schema and returns an inclusivity score, gender coding read, and flagged phrases with rewrites. The result is formatted into an HTML report and shown back on the form.

parameters.formTitle: Job Description Bias & Inclusive Language Checker
parameters.formDescription: Paste a job description below. Get an inclusivity score, a gender-coding read, and every phrase that could be discouraging qualified candidates from applying, with a suggested inclusive rewrite for each one.

parameters.responseText:
Please paste the full job description

Add at least a few sentences (150+ characters) covering the role and requirements so the analysis is accurate. Go back and try again.

parameters.text:
=You are a DEI-aware job description editor who applies the same principles as established gender-decoder research (Gaucher, Friesen & Kay) and inclusive-hiring best practices.

Role title: {{ $json.roleTitle }}
Industry: {{ $json.industry }}

Analyze the JOB DESCRIPTION below and respond with:
1. inclusivity_score: 0-100 (100 = highly inclusive and welcoming to all qualified candidates)
2. overall_summary: 1-2 plain-English sentences summarizing the main issue, or confirming it reads well if there is nothing notable
3. gender_coding: an object with lean (Masculine-coded, Feminine-coded, or Neutral), masculine_words_found (array of actual words/phrases from the text, e.g. competitive, dominant, rockstar, ninja, aggressive), feminine_words_found (array of actual words/phrases from the text, e.g. collaborative, supportive, nurturing, compassionate), and a one-sentence note
4. flags: an array of every phrase that could discourage qualified candidates from applying. For each one include:
   - phrase: the relevant text quoted or closely paraphrased from the job description
   - category: one of Gender-Coded, Ageist, Ableist, Aggressive/Combative Language, Unnecessary Requirement, Culture-Fit Buzzword, Other
   - severity: High, Medium, or Low
   - explanation: plain-English reason this could discourage applicants
   - suggested_rewrite: a more inclusive version of the same phrase that keeps the original meaning
5. readability_note: one sentence on length and clarity of the requirements section

Rules:
- Never invent a phrase that is not in the text
- If the text reads as genuinely inclusive, say so in overall_summary and return a short or empty flags array
- Do not flag legitimate, job-relevant technical or legal requirements (like a required certification) as bias

JOB DESCRIPTION:
{{ $json.jdText }}
